outcome: Vertical transmission (RT-PCR SARS-CoV-2 positivity among newborns)
cohort: Pregnant women with detected SARS-CoV-2 infection were registered in 23 Portuguese maternity hospitals.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnancy may carry increased risks for both pregnant women and fetuses, including elevated rates of preterm birth, fetal death, and vertical transmission.
mod_finding: The caesarean section rate was higher in the first wave (68.5%) compared to the second wave (31.5%).
followup_time: Up to immediate postpartum for mothers and at birth for newborns.
birth_weight: N/A (mentions 'small-to-gestational-age' but no specific weight range for the cohort)
gest_age: Included pregnancies at various gestational ages, with 87.9% being at term.
